mfs_amt_increase.basis: Section 55(d)(2) special increase after the MFS exemption fully phases out; the 2026 substitution in 55(d)(4)(A)(ii)(IV) changes 25% to 50%.

active_qbi_minimum.basis: Section 199A(i): material participation in an eligible active qualified trade or business. Future indexed limits are not projected.

va_purchase.basis: Prior use only to purchase a manufactured home retains the first-use fee. Exemption is an entered eligibility assumption; refinancing and other VA loan types are excluded.

social_security.basis: Ideal-age input is FRA PIA in age 62 dollars. Assumed annual COLA applies during the waiting period and after claiming; discount rate is nominal. Separately entered comparison quotes are claim-date amounts. Future COLA is a user assumption, not a published fixed rate.
